label: Bandel cheese
note: Portuguese-era cheese from Bandel, Bengal: cow-milk curd set with lemon juice, moulded in small baskets, well salted; the brown kind is smoked

about.text: Bandel cheese is a small round, salted and often smoked unripened cheese from West Bengal, introduced by the Portuguese at Bandel and made today mainly near Kolkata. It is like Surti paneer but made from cow's milk.

how.label: salt, mould, smoke
how.text: Lemon juice curdles the hot milk as for chhena; the curd is moulded, salted and optionally smoked. Heat of the milk and smoking method are not given.

steps.note: Lemon juice curdles the hot milk.

steps.note: Optional: plain cheese is white, smoked cheese brown.
